nodes.title: rc4 stabilization: fixes filed after the themed-milestone rule

acceptance: test_message_while_running_queues_and_delivers polls until the second completion event is recorded and the worker record is no longer running, within the same 30-second deadline; it still asserts queued_message is None, state idle, the message and resumed events, and the follow-up prompt file
No product code changes and no assertion is removed or weakened; the root cause (the completion event is written before the record leaves running) is stated in the test's comment
The test passes 20 consecutive runs under pytest -n auto with a parallel CPU load (for example pytest-repeat or a loop), recorded in the sheet
nodes.title: The queued-message worker test waits for the idle state, not just the second completion event

acceptance: specy-road init project (not --dry-run) also writes roadmap.md and roadmap-context.md from the scaffold graph by reusing generated_files.regenerate_generated_files, and lists both in its written paths; --dry-run lists them as would-write and writes nothing

The starter roster placeholder (id my-executor, no harness and no channels.cli) produces no 'matches no model profile' notice; a real unmatched roster id still gets the notice, and its 'closest profile' hint is shown only when the closest name passes a similarity cutoff, so an unrelated profile is never suggested

New test: init project into a tmp git repo, make the first commit, then run validate, validate --strict, export --check and digest --check in-process; all exit 0 and stderr has no notice or warning naming a scaffold file or the placeholder roster entry. The vision.md touch-zone notice is untracked-only (verified: it clears after the first commit), so the zone check is not changed
docs/install-and-usage.md new-project line states that init writes both generated files and that the first commit precedes validate; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed entry
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +25, tests about +60, docs about +5
nodes.title: A freshly initialized project passes its own checks

acceptance: When the resolved remote (--remote, git-workflow.yaml, else origin) is not configured in the repo (git remote get-url fails), doctor skips git fetch and the remote-backed branch and registry sections, prints one informational line naming the missing remote and that those checks were skipped, still runs the install, checkout, stash and orphaned-claim reports, and exits 0 unless one of those fails
A configured remote whose fetch fails (bad URL, network) still exits 1 with the existing 'git fetch --prune <remote> failed' error; branches prune is unchanged

Table-driven test in tests/test_doctor.py over three cases: no remote (exit 0, the informational line, no fetch error), remote present (unchanged listing, exit 0), fetch failing for another reason (exit 1, existing error)
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +15, tests about +25
nodes.title: doctor works in a repo with no remote

acceptance: specy-road --help points add-node and scaffold-planning at 'specy-road <cmd> -h', never python specy_road/bundled_scripts/... paths; the gui line names the canonical 'specy-road init gui --install-gui' (the only form the init parser accepts) with pip install 'specy-road[gui-next]' as the alternative; no command or flag is removed

Subcommand help 'usage:' lines read 'specy-road <cmd>' instead of the module file name (roadmap_crud.py, validate_roadmap.py, ...), set once in cli._run for every bundled entrypoint rather than per script

Help text no longer cites a bare docs/<name>.md that pip installs lack: each is rewritten to the published URL with doc_links.link_toolkit_docs (top-level usage, apply, do-next-available-task --on-complete) or dropped

New tests/test_cli_help_text.py runs specy-road --help and '<cmd> -h' for every name in cli._known_commands() and fails on 'bundled_scripts/', on a usage line or 'python ...' naming a .py file, and on a bare docs/<name>.md outside doc_links.SHIPPED_DOCS; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed entry
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +15, tests about +40
nodes.title: Help text names installed commands
